lines: Girl: This swimming pool is twenty metres long. How wide is it?
Man: Ten metres wide.
Girl: How deep is it?
Man: One metre deep at this end. It is safe for beginners here.

qs.text: How deep is the pool at this end?
qs.clue: One metre deep at this end.

ten metres 是宽度，不是深度。
twenty metres 是长度，不是深度。

qs.point: how deep 问深度；at this end 限定为泳池这一端。

qs.text: How wide is the swimming pool?
qs.clue: Ten metres wide.

twenty metres 是长度，不是宽度。
one metre 是这一端的深度。

qs.point: how wide 问宽度；区分 long、wide、deep。

lines: Girl: Ben, will you buy some apples today?
Boy: No. I will buy them tomorrow.
Girl: How many apples will you buy?
Boy: Six. Three for Mum and three for Dad.

qs.text: How many apples will Ben buy?
qs.clue: Six. Three for Mum and three for Dad.

three 只是给其中一人的数量，合计为 six。
有两位收礼人，不是两个苹果。

qs.point: how many 问可数数量；注意总数和部分数量。

qs.text: Will Ben buy the apples today?
qs.answer: No, he will buy them tomorrow.
choices: No, he will buy them tomorrow.
Yes, he will buy them today.
qs.clue: No. I will buy them tomorrow.

原文说 tomorrow，还没有购买。

qs.point: Will 开头问将来的安排；区分 today 和 tomorrow。

lines: Boy: I would like a bottle of water, please.
Woman: This small bottle is two yuan. The big one is four yuan.
Boy: I will take the big one. How much water is in it?
Woman: One litre.

qs.text: How much water is in the big bottle?
qs.clue: One litre.

原文没有说 half a litre。
two 是小瓶价格的数字，不是大瓶水量。

qs.point: how much + 不可数名词问数量；water 的量用容量单位。

qs.text: How much does the big bottle of water cost?
qs.clue: The big one is four yuan.

two yuan 是小瓶的价格。
one 是水量对应的数字，不是价格。

qs.point: how much + cost 问价格；核对 big 和 small。

lines: Boy: How heavy is your new bike, May?
Girl: It is twelve kilograms. My old bike was fifteen kilograms.
Boy: How fast do you usually ride the new bike?
Girl: About ten kilometres an hour.

qs.text: How heavy is May's new bike?
qs.clue: It is twelve kilograms.

15 kilograms 是旧自行车的重量。
ten 是速度中的数字，不是重量。

qs.point: how heavy 问重量；区分 new 和 old。

qs.text: How fast does May usually ride her new bike?
qs.clue: About ten kilometres an hour.

12 是新车重量，不是骑行速度。
15 是旧车重量，不是骑行速度。

qs.point: how fast 问速度；注意 kilometres an hour 这个单位。

lines: Boy: Were you and your sister at the zoo yesterday, Nina?
Girl: No. We were at home for her birthday.
Boy: How old is your sister now?
Girl: She is eight. I am fifteen.

qs.text: Were Nina and her sister at the zoo yesterday?
choices: Yes, they were at the zoo.
qs.clue: No. We were at home for her birthday.
qs.point: Were 开头问过去复数主语的状态或位置。

qs.text: How old is Nina's sister now?
qs.clue: She is eight. I am fifteen.

fifteen 是 Nina 的年龄。
妹妹现在 eight，不是 seven。

qs.point: how old 问年龄；注意 she 和 I 指不同的人。

lines: Boy: May I join your birthday party, Kate?
Girl: Of course! All my friends are welcome.
Boy: What is the date of your party?
Girl: November twelfth. My birthday is on November tenth.

qs.text: May the boy join Kate's party?
qs.answer: Yes, he may join the party.
choices: No, only her family can come.
Yes, he may join the party.
No, he must wait until next year.
qs.clue: Of course! All my friends are welcome.

Kate 说欢迎朋友，不是只邀请家人。

qs.point: May 开头问许可；Of course 表示同意。

qs.text: What is the date of Kate's party?
qs.clue: November twelfth.

November 10th 是生日日期，不是聚会日期。

qs.point: 问日期要听月份和日子；生日与聚会不一定在同一天。

lines: Boy: Lucy, do you walk to school?
Girl: No. I take the bus every morning.
Boy: Where do you catch the bus?
Girl: In front of the park, near my home.

qs.text: Where does Lucy catch the bus?
qs.clue: In front of the park, near my home.

school 是目的地，不是上车地点。
原文是 in front of，不是 behind。

qs.point: where 问地点；听清方位词。

qs.text: Does Lucy walk to school?
qs.clue: No. I take the bus every morning.

Lucy 明确说 No，没有步行。
交通方式是 bus，没有提到骑车。

qs.point: Does 开头问是否；先判断肯否，再核对交通方式。

lines: Boy: Would you like to go to the park with me, Lily?
Girl: Yes, I would love to.
Boy: Which gate shall we meet at, the east gate or the west gate?
Girl: The west gate. It is near my home.

qs.text: Which gate will they meet at?
qs.clue: The west gate.

east 只是提问时给出的另一选择。

qs.point: which 问在范围内选哪一个；以最终选择为准。

qs.text: Would Lily like to go to the park?
choices: No, she wants to stay at home.
No, she wants to go shopping.
qs.clue: Yes, I would love to.

Lily 接受邀请，没有说留在家。

qs.point: Would ... like to ...? 问意愿；would love to 表示愿意。

lines: Boy: Who is that man beside your father, Amy?
Girl: He is my uncle, Mr Green.
Boy: Is he a doctor like your father?
Girl: No. He is a teacher at my school.

qs.text: Who is the man beside Amy's father?
qs.clue: He is my uncle, Mr Green.

没有说他是老师的父亲。

qs.point: who 问人物；不要把职业和亲属关系混淆。

qs.text: Is Amy's uncle a doctor?
qs.clue: No. He is a teacher at my school.

doctor 是父亲的职业，叔叔是 teacher。

qs.point: Is 开头问身份或状态；注意不同人物的职业。

lines: Girl: Dad, what will we do this afternoon?
Man: We will make a cake for Mum.
Girl: Shall I buy some eggs now?
Man: Yes, please. There are no eggs at home.

qs.text: Shall the girl buy some eggs now?
qs.answer: Yes, there are no eggs at home.
choices: No, there are enough eggs at home.
Yes, there are no eggs at home.
No, her father bought eggs this morning.
qs.clue: Yes, please. There are no eggs at home.

原文说没有鸡蛋，不是足够。

qs.point: Shall 开头在此征求意见；there are no 表示没有。

qs.text: What will the girl and her father do this afternoon?
qs.clue: We will make a cake for Mum.

make 是制作，不是买成品蛋糕。

qs.point: what 问活动内容；听动词和宾语。

lines: Woman: Have you found the shoes you want, Lisa?
Girl: Not yet. These size thirty-six shoes are too small.
Woman: What size do you need?
Girl: Size thirty-seven, please.

qs.text: What size shoes does Lisa need?
qs.clue: Size thirty-seven, please.

size 36 太小，是已试过的尺码。

qs.point: what size 问尺码；too small 的尺码不是最终所需。

qs.text: Have Lisa and the woman found the right shoes for Lisa?
qs.answer: No, they have not found them yet.
choices: Yes, the size 36 shoes are right.
Yes, the size 38 shoes are right.
No, they have not found them yet.
qs.clue: Not yet. These size thirty-six shoes are too small.

没有找到或试穿 38 码的线索。

qs.point: Have 开头问是否已经完成；not yet 表示还没有。

lines: Girl: Why are you staying at home today, Sam?
Boy: I have a cold.
Girl: Should I bring your homework to you?
Boy: Yes, please. Thank you for helping me.

qs.text: Why is Sam staying at home?
qs.clue: I have a cold.

原文有人帮忙送作业，不是因为没有作业。

qs.point: why 问原因；have a cold 表示感冒。

qs.text: Should the girl bring Sam's homework to him?
qs.answer: Yes, he wants her to bring it.
choices: No, he will go to school now.
No, he has already finished it.
Yes, he wants her to bring it.
qs.clue: Yes, please. Thank you for helping me.

Sam 接受帮忙，没有说作业已完成。
他因感冒在家，没有说现在去学校。

qs.point: Should 开头在此询问是否需要帮忙；Yes, please 表示接受。

lines: Boy: Mum, must I finish my homework before dinner?
Woman: No, you needn't. You can finish it after dinner.
Boy: How soon will dinner be ready?
Woman: In ten minutes.

qs.text: How soon will dinner be ready?
qs.clue: In ten minutes.
qs.point: how soon 问多久以后；常用 in + 一段时间回答。

qs.text: Must the boy finish his homework before dinner?
qs.answer: No, he can finish it after dinner.
choices: No, he does not need to do it at all.
Yes, he must finish it before dinner.
No, he can finish it after dinner.
qs.clue: No, you needn't. You can finish it after dinner.

母亲否定了“必须饭前做完”。
只是可以饭后完成，不是不用做作业。

qs.point: Must 问是否必须；No, needn't 表示不必，不表示禁止。

lines: Girl: Do you play basketball every day, Peter?
Boy: No. I only play on Tuesday and Friday.
Girl: So you play twice a week?
Boy: That is right. I play with my friends.

qs.text: Do Peter and his friends play basketball every day?
qs.answer: No, they play twice a week.
choices: No, they play once a month.
No, they play twice a week.
qs.clue: No. I only play on Tuesday and Friday. / I play with my friends.
qs.point: Do 开头问是否；区分 every day 和每周两次。

qs.text: How often does Peter play basketball?
qs.clue: I only play on Tuesday and Friday. / twice a week

every day 在对话中被否定。

qs.point: how often 问频率；twice a week 表示每周两次。

lines: Boy: Has Emma finished her picture?
Girl: Yes. Look, it is on the table.
Boy: What colour is the bird in her picture?
Girl: It is yellow. The tree beside it is green.

qs.text: What colour is the bird in Emma's picture?
qs.clue: It is yellow.
qs.point: what colour 问颜色；把颜色与对应物品匹配。

qs.text: Has Emma finished her picture?
choices: No, she has not started it.
No, she is still drawing it.
qs.clue: Yes. Look, it is on the table.

原文明确说完成，没有说未开始。
没有说仍在画；成品已在桌上。

qs.point: Has 开头在此询问是否已经完成。

lines: Girl: Is our music lesson on Tuesday, Ben?
Boy: No. It is on Friday this week.
Girl: Does it start at four?
Boy: No. It starts at half past four.

qs.text: What day is the music lesson this week?
qs.clue: It is on Friday this week.
qs.point: what day 问星期几；注意纠正后的信息。

qs.text: Am I right that the music lesson starts at four?
qs.answer: No, it starts at half past four.
choices: No, it starts at half past five.
No, it starts at half past four.
qs.clue: It starts at half past four.

是 four 的半点，不是 five 的半点。

qs.point: Am I right that ...? 表示“我认为……对吗”；核对后半句。

lines: Girl: Was your train late yesterday, Mike?
Boy: Yes. It was twenty minutes late.
Girl: How long did the journey take?
Boy: Two hours. I read a book on the train.

qs.text: How long did Mike's train journey take?
qs.clue: Two hours.

twenty minutes 是晚点时间，不是旅程时长。

qs.point: how long 问持续时长；区分旅程用时和晚点时长。

qs.text: Was Mike's train late yesterday?
qs.answer: Yes, it was twenty minutes late.
choices: Yes, it was twenty minutes late.
Yes, it was two hours late.
qs.clue: It was twenty minutes late.

two hours 是旅程时长，不是晚点时长。

qs.point: Was 开头问过去状态；同一对话中不同时间数字各有用途。

lines: Girl: Tom, how will you get to the library tomorrow?
Boy: By bus. My bike is broken.
Girl: Will you go with your father?
Boy: No. I will go with my uncle Jack.

qs.text: How will Tom get to the library tomorrow?
qs.clue: By bus. My bike is broken.

自行车坏了，不会骑车去。

qs.point: how 问方式；交通方式常用 by + 交通工具。

qs.text: Whom will Tom go to the library with?
qs.clue: I will go with my uncle Jack.

Jack 的身份是 uncle，不是 friend。

qs.point: whom 在此问 with 的对象，即“和谁一起”。

lines: Girl: Jack, whose red bag is this?
Boy: It is my sister's. My bag is blue.
Girl: Are your books in the red bag?
Boy: No. My books are in my blue bag.

qs.text: Whose red bag is this?
qs.clue: It is my sister's.

Jack 的包是蓝色，红色包属于姐姐或妹妹。

qs.point: whose 问所属关系；回答要表达“某人的”。

qs.text: Are Jack's books in the red bag?
qs.answer: No, they are in the blue bag.
choices: No, they are in the blue bag.
No, they are on the desk.
Yes, they are in the red bag.
qs.clue: My books are in my blue bag.

红色包不是书所在的包。

qs.point: Are 开头问复数事物的位置；注意 my 指 Jack。

lines: Girl: How tall is your brother, Leo?
Boy: He is one hundred and seventy centimetres tall.
Girl: Look at the wall beside him. How high is it?
Boy: Two metres. It is higher than he is.

qs.text: How high is the wall?
qs.clue: Two metres.
qs.point: how high 在此问墙的高度；别把人物身高代入。

qs.text: How tall is Leo's brother?
qs.clue: one hundred and seventy centimetres tall

Two metres 是墙高，不是兄弟的身高。

qs.point: how tall 常问人的身高；核对数字和对象。

lines: Girl: Could you walk to the new library from your home, David?
Boy: Yes. It is only one kilometre away.
Girl: How long does the walk take?
Boy: About fifteen minutes.

qs.text: How far is the new library from David's home?
qs.clue: It is only one kilometre away.

fifteen 是步行分钟数，不是公里数。

qs.point: how far 问距离；不要把时间当作距离。

qs.text: Could David walk to the new library from his home?
choices: No, he would have to take a train.
No, he would have to take a taxi.
qs.clue: Yes. It is only one kilometre away.

David 明确说可以步行，没有说必须坐火车。

qs.point: Could 开头在此问可行性；根据明确的 Yes 判断。

lines: Girl: Tom, when is your school trip?
Boy: Next Friday. We will visit a farm.
Girl: Can you ride a horse there?
Boy: No, but we can feed the animals.

qs.text: When is Tom's school trip?
qs.clue: Next Friday.
qs.point: when 问时间；同时听清 next 和星期。

qs.text: Can Tom ride a horse on the farm?
qs.answer: No, but he can feed the animals.
choices: Yes, he can ride a horse.
No, but he can feed the animals.
No, but he can drive a car.
qs.clue: No, but we can feed the animals.

原文说喂动物，没有说开车。

qs.point: Can 开头问能否做某事；but 后常有另一个活动。

lines: Boy: What kind of books do you like, Rose?
Girl: Books about animals. I like reading about cats and dogs.
Boy: Might your brother enjoy this animal book too?
Girl: Yes, he might. He also loves animals.

qs.text: What kind of books does Rose like?
qs.clue: Books about animals.
qs.point: what kind of 问种类；about 后说明书的主题。

qs.text: Might Rose's brother enjoy the animal book?
choices: No, he only likes sports books.
qs.clue: Yes, he might. He also loves animals.

弟弟也喜欢动物，不是只喜欢运动书。

qs.point: Might 开头问可能性；might 不表示已经发生或一定发生。

lines: Boy: What about going swimming this afternoon, Sue?
Girl: Sorry, I have to do my homework this afternoon.
Boy: How about playing table tennis tomorrow?
Girl: Good idea! Let's meet at three tomorrow afternoon.

qs.text: How about playing table tennis tomorrow? What is Sue's answer?
qs.answer: Good idea! She will meet the boy at three.
choices: She would rather go swimming tomorrow.
Good idea! She will meet the boy at three.
Sorry, she has to do her homework tomorrow.
qs.clue: Good idea! Let's meet at three tomorrow afternoon.

reasons.Sorry, she has to do her homework tomorr: 做作业指今天下午，不是明天。
她接受打乒乓球，没有改为明天游泳。

qs.point: How about + doing 也可提建议；不要混淆两次建议的回应。

qs.text: What about going swimming this afternoon? What is Sue's answer?
qs.answer: Sorry, she has to do her homework.
choices: Sorry, she has to do her homework.
Good idea! She is free this afternoon.
qs.clue: Sorry, I have to do my homework this afternoon.

Good idea 是对明天打乒乓球的回应。

qs.point: What about + doing 在此提建议；听对方接受还是拒绝。

lines: Boy: Which class are you in, Mary?
Girl: Class Three. My brother is in Class Two.
Boy: Are you both in Grade Nine?
Girl: No. He is in Grade Nine, but I am in Grade Eight.

qs.text: Which grade is Mary in?
qs.clue: He is in Grade Nine, but I am in Grade Eight.

Grade Nine 是兄弟的年级。
Three 是班级编号，不是年级。

qs.point: which grade 问年级；class 和 grade 不能混淆。

qs.text: Which class is Mary in?
qs.clue: Class Three. My brother is in Class Two.

Class Two 是哥哥或弟弟的班级。
Eight 是 Mary 的年级，不是班级。

qs.point: which class 问班级；区分本人和兄弟的信息。

lines: Boy: Anna, did you watch TV last night?
Girl: No. I read a book instead.
Boy: What time did you go to bed?
Girl: At half past nine, after I finished reading.

qs.text: Did Anna watch TV last night?
qs.clue: No. I read a book instead.

替代活动是 read a book，不是玩游戏。

qs.point: Did 开头问过去发生的事；听实际做了什么。

qs.text: What time did Anna go to bed?
qs.clue: At half past nine.

half past nine 表示九点半，不是九点。
小时数为 nine，不是 ten。

qs.point: what time 问几点；half past nine = 9:30。
